findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability
 * @description XML parsers that resolve external entities without proper configuration can lead to XXE attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe-vulnerability
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // lxml.etree parsing functions that may be vulnerable
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "XMLParser", "XMLParse", "fromstring", "XML", "iterparse"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("objectify").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    // xml.etree parsing
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML", "iterparse"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "XMLParser"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "XML parsing operation that may be vulnerable to XXE attacks if external entities are not disabled."
findings.hypothesis: Detect XML parsing operations that could be vulnerable to XXE attacks

/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of potentially dangerous function that can execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for usage of eval, exec, compile, or __import__ which can lead to code injection

/**
 * @name Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
 * @description Fetching URLs without validation can lead to SSRF attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/ssrf-vulnerability
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("ftplib").getMember("FTP").getACall()
  )
select call, "URL fetching operation that may be vulnerable to SSRF if URL is user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: SSRF via unvalidated URL fetching using urllib or other HTTP libraries

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential XSS via unsafe HTML handling
 * @description HTML operations that may not properly sanitize user input could lead to XSS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xss-html-handling
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // lxml.html functions that parse HTML without sanitization
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("html").getMember(["fromstring", "fragment_fromstring", "fragments_fromstring", "document_fromstring"]).getACall() or
    // HTML builder operations
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("html").getMember("builder").getMember("E").getACall() or
    // Direct HTML element creation
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("html").getMember("Element").getACall()
  )
select call, "HTML parsing or creation that may not sanitize user input, potentially leading to XSS."
findings.hypothesis: HTML parsing functions in lxml.html that don't sanitize input could lead to XSS vulnerabilities
